origin.says: 女 (a kneeling woman) with two dots added for the breasts: a nursing mother.

母.name: mother
母.in: 每海毒繁敏悔姆侮霉梅拇诲晦

origin.says: 辶 (walk) for the meaning plus a sound part: far away. Traditional 遠 had 袁 as the sound; the simplified form uses 元 (first), a folk shorthand since about the Song dynasty.

念.def: to think of, to recall; to study

ety.hint: To keep the present 今 in mind 心

origin.says: 心 (heart) with 今 (now) on top; one reading takes 今 as the sound, another as an upside-down mouth, "listening to one's heart". To think of, to miss; also to read aloud.

念.name: think of

ety.hint: Four cooking vessels 口 guarded by a dog 犬

origin.says: Four 口 (mouths) around 犬 (dog); the original meaning is unclear. One reading: vessels guarded by a dog, hence utensils. Another: the mouths are a dog's barking, first a word for barking. A third links it to 喪 (mourning) and a funeral urn.
亻 (person) for the meaning plus 列 (row) as the sound: something set in a row to follow, a precedent or example.
亻 (person) for the meaning plus 乃 (then, so) as the sound: going on as before, still.

讲.def: talk, speech, lecture; to speak, to explain

origin.says: From 講: 言 (speech) for the meaning plus 冓 (framework) as the sound: to speak, explain. Simplified with 言 written 讠 and 冓 replaced by 井 (well).

讲.name: lecture

origin.says: Simplified from 勢: 埶 (to plant) as the sound plus 力 (strength) for the meaning: power, force. The simplified form writes 埶 as 执 (to hold).
𥫗 (bamboo) for the meaning plus 间 (gap) as the sound: bamboo strips for writing, then letter and simple. Simplified from 簡.

评.def: to appraise, to criticize, to evaluate

origin.says: 讠 (speech) for the meaning plus 平 (level, fair) as the sound, which also hints at judging fairly: to appraise, to comment on. Simplified from 評 by writing 言 (speech) as 讠.

评.name: appraise

origin.says: 君 (ruler) as the sound plus 羊 (sheep) for the meaning: a flock of sheep, hence any group or crowd.

ety.hint: A group of people that swear by 矢 a single flag 方

origin.says: 㫃 (flag, written 方 plus 𠂉) plus 矢 (arrow): armed men gathered under one flag, a clan.

ety.hint: The first rays 十 of the sun 日

origin.says: Bronze forms put 日 (sun) for the meaning over 棗 (jujube) as the sound; the sound part was cut down until it looked like 十 (ten). Another reading takes it as the sun rising over a mark; the early history is disputed.

早.name: early morning
早.in: 章障草掉罩卓悼彰绰谭樟潭赣

origin.says: 亻 (person) for the meaning plus 直 (straight) as the sound: to meet, to hold a post, then to be worth: value, price.

ety.hint: A place where measures 尺 are discussed 口

origin.says: 尸 (a body) for the meaning plus 句 (hooked) as the sound, first meaning cramped, bent. The 句 has been squeezed so its parts are no longer recognisable; later meanings: a board game, a situation, an office.

ety.hint: A person 各 welcomed under one's roof 宀; 各 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 宀 (roof) for the meaning plus 各 (each; first a foot arriving) as the sound: someone who arrives under your roof, a guest.
氵 (water) for the meaning plus 弯 (bend) as the sound and sense: where water bends into the land, a bay. Simplified from 灣.

担.def: to bear, to carry; burden, responsibility

origin.says: Simplified from 擔: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 詹 (talkative) as the sound, to carry. The new form keeps 扌 (hand) and takes 旦 (dawn) as a simpler sound part.

担.name: carry load

令.def: command, decree, order; magistrate; to allow, to cause

ety.hint: A person kneeling before a master 人

origin.says: An open mouth (亼) above a kneeling person (卩): someone receiving orders, a command. The kneeling person has shrunk to two small strokes, so the top now looks like 今 (now) plus a dot.

令.name: command
令.in: 领命冷零龄邻怜铃玲伶拎岭聆羚

引.def: to pull, to stretch; to draw; to attract

ety.hint: To pull back a bow's 弓 drawstring 丨

origin.says: 弓 (bow) with a short stroke marking where the string is drawn: to draw a bow, hence to pull and to lead.

引.name: draw bow

拿.def: to bring, to grasp, to hold, to take

origin.says: 合 (put together) over 手 (hand): hands closing on something, to take or hold. It replaced the older 拏 (手 hand + 奴 slave as the sound).

拿.name: take hold

ety.hint: Using a tool 殳 to sort items on a tray 舟

origin.says: A hand with a tool, 殳 (weapon, tool), beside a part that was first 凡 (tray) and later reshaped into 舟 (boat). One reading: turning or moving; another: 凡 as the sound. 'Kind, sort' is a later use.
疒 (sickbed) for the meaning plus 丙 (third stem) as the sound: illness, disease.
纟 (silk thread) for the meaning plus 戋 (small) as the sound: a thread or line. Simplified from 綫 (also written 線 with 泉 spring as the sound).

积.def: to store up, to amass, to accumulate

origin.says: Simplified from 積: 禾 (grain) for the meaning plus 責 as the sound: to pile up grain, to accumulate. 責 was replaced by the simpler 只 (only).

积.name: pile up

星.def: star, planet; a point of light

origin.says: Oracle-bone forms draw several small circles (stars), later with 生 (life) added as the sound. The three circles 晶 (sparkle) were reduced to one 日 (sun).

星.name: star

录.def: to copy, to record, to write down

ety.hint: A brush used to record stories

origin.says: Stands for 錄: 金 (metal) for the meaning plus 彔 for the sound, first 'golden colour', then borrowed for 'to record'. The simplification dropped 金 and kept 录, a form of the sound part 彔.

录.name: write down

ety.hint: Cutting 刀 the cloth 衤 is the first step in making clothes

origin.says: 衤 (clothes) beside 刀 (knife): cutting the cloth is the first step in making clothes, hence beginning.

状.def: state, condition; shape, appearance, form; certificate

origin.says: Simplified from 狀: 犬 (dog) for the meaning plus 爿 (plank) as the sound, now written ⺦: first a dog's shape, then shape and condition in general.

状.name: condition

origin.says: 户 (a one-leaf door) for the meaning plus 方 (square, side) as the sound. It first meant the side rooms of a house, then any room or house.
木 (tree) for the meaning plus 寸 (inch) as the sound: a village among trees. A late character that took over from 邨 (village).

ety.hint: A hand using a chisel 殳 to cut stone

origin.says: A hand holding a hammer, 殳 (tool), striking stone under a cliff, with chips flying off: first 'to forge', now written 鍛. 'Section, piece' is a borrowed use; one reading also takes 厂 (cliff) as the sound.

占.def: to divine; to observe; to versify

origin.says: ⺊ (a crack in an oracle bone) plus 口 (mouth): reading out the cracks made in bone or shell, to divine.

占.name: divine
占.in: 点站战店贴钻沾粘惦帖玷毡掂

尽.def: to exhaust, to use up, to deplete

origin.says: From 盡: a hand with a brush scrubbing a 皿 (dish) after the food is all eaten, hence used up, to the end. The simplified form is a cursive shortening that looks like 尺 (foot ruler) with two dots.

尽.name: use up

origin.says: 米 (rice) for the meaning plus 青 as the sound: finely polished rice, hence the refined part, essence, spirit.
氵 (water) for the meaning plus 罙 (deep) as the sound: deep water, deep. Inside 罙 the top was once 穴 (cave).

宣.def: to proclaim, to declare, to announce; surname

ety.hint: A palace, where proclamations are made

origin.says: 宀 (roof) for the meaning plus 亘 (spanning) as the sound: first a large hall of the palace, where edicts were proclaimed; to announce.

宣.name: proclaim

似.def: resembling, similar to; as if, to seem

origin.says: 亻 (person) for the meaning plus 以 (by means of) as the sound: one person resembling another.

似.name: look-alike

谈.def: to talk, to chat; conversation; surname

origin.says: 讠 (speech) for the meaning plus 炎 (blaze) as the sound: to talk. Simplified from 談, where 言 (speech) was shortened to 讠.

谈.name: chat

愿.def: desire, wish; honest, virtuous; ready, willing

origin.says: 愿 was its own character, 原 (origin) as the sound plus 心 (heart): sincere, honest. Simplification made it also stand for 願 (原 plus 頁 (head)), a wish: so now wish, hope, be willing.

愿.name: wish

免.def: to spare, to excuse from; to evade

origin.says: A drawing of a person wearing a ceremonial hat (now written 冕). The meanings to spare, to avoid are sound loans.

免.name: spare

播.def: to sow seeds, to scatter; to broadcast, to spread

ety.hint: To sow seeds 番 by hand 扌; 番 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 番 (turn) as the sound: to scatter seed by hand, to sow; hence to spread, to broadcast.

播.name: sow

席.def: seat, place; mat; banquet; to take a seat

ety.hint: A cloth 巾 or straw 艹 mat in the house 广

origin.says: First a drawing of a woven mat; 石 (stone) was added as the sound, and the mat wore into 巾 (cloth) while 石 wore into 广 + 廿. A mat, a seat, a banquet.

席.name: mat seat

origin.says: Simplified from 絡 (糹 became 纟): 纟 (silk thread) for the meaning plus 各 (each) as the sound: threads wrapped into a web, a net.

ety.hint: A dish of food 良 with a lid on top 人

origin.says: A lid or mouth (亼) over 皀 (a bowl of food on a stand): food, to eat. The bowl has changed into a shape like 良 (good), to which it is unrelated.

域.def: area, district, field, land, region; boundary; domain (in taxonomy)

origin.says: 土 (earth) for the meaning plus 或 (defended land) as the sound: a stretch of land, region, domain. Added once 或 was taken for 'or'.

域.name: region

承.def: to undertake, to bear, to accept a duty; inheritance

ety.hint: Three hands 手 lifting a dead body 了

origin.says: Two hands lifting a kneeling person: to hold up, to carry, to bear. A third hand 手 (hand) was added in seal script, and the parts have run together in the modern shape.

承.name: bear up

察.def: to examine, to investigate, to observe

origin.says: 宀 (roof) for the meaning plus 祭 (sacrifice) as the sound: looking closely into things under the roof, to examine.

察.name: examine

控.def: to accuse, to charge; to control; to sue

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 空 (empty) as the sound: to pull a bow, then hold in check, control, and to accuse.

控.name: control

ety.hint: A hand 乂 holding an axe 八

origin.says: A picture of a hand holding a stone axe or rod: the man who works and leads, the father.

预.def: to prepare, to arrange; in advance

origin.says: Simplified from 預: 頁 (head, shortened to 页) for the meaning plus 予 (give) as the sound: thinking ahead, in advance.

预.name: in advance

ety.hint: Avoiding 免 the sun 日; 免 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 日 (sun) for the meaning plus 免 as the sound: late in the day, evening, late.
From 飛, a picture of a bird flying up with spread wings. The simplified form keeps only the upper wing strokes.
From 擇: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 睪 (spy) as the sound: to pick out by hand, choose. 睪 was replaced by the simpler 𠬤.

判.def: to judge; to discriminate; to conclude

origin.says: 刂 (knife) for the meaning plus 半 (half) as the sound: to cut in two, hence to divide and to judge between things.

判.name: judge

origin.says: 艹 (plant) for the meaning plus 氾 (to flood) as the sound: first a plant and a surname. It also took over 範 (a casting mould, model), built from 車 (cart) and a shortened 笵.

留.def: to stay, to remain; to preserve, to keep; to leave a message;

origin.says: 田 (field) as the meaning part plus a top that bronze forms write as 卯 (mortise) and seal script as 丣, both for the sound: to stop and stay, then to keep.

留.name: stay

破.def: to break, to rout; to ruin, to destroy

origin.says: 石 (stone) for the meaning plus 皮 (skin) as the sound: stone splitting apart, to break.

破.name: break

志.def: determination, will; mark, sign; to record, to write

ety.hint: The mind 心 of a scholar 士; 士 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: The top was 之 (to go) as sound and meaning over 心 (heart): where the heart is heading, will, aim. The top later became 士 (scholar). Simplification also folded 誌 (record) into it.

志.name: willpower

依.def: to rely on; to consent, to obey; according to

origin.says: 亻 (person) for the meaning plus 衣 (clothes) as the sound: a person leaning on someone, to rely on; also according to.

依.name: lean on

围.def: to surround, to encircle, to corral

origin.says: Simplified from 圍: 囗 (enclosure) for the meaning plus 韦 as the sound. 韋 itself first meant 'to go around'; the enclosure was added to make 'to surround'.

围.name: surround

ety.hint: A man's face blacked by soot from a fire 灬

origin.says: Possibly a picture of a person with a marked or tattooed face; later read as a chimney blackened by fire, and the bottom was reshaped like fire. Means black, dark. The oracle-bone form is uncertain.
阝 (hill) for the meaning plus 佥 (all) as the sound: a steep, dangerous pass, then danger. Simplified from 險 by shortening 僉 to 佥.

斯.def: this, thus, such; emphatic particle; used in transliterations

origin.says: 斤 (axe) for the meaning plus 其 (basket) as the sound: to split with an axe, a sense later written 撕 (tear). Borrowed for 'this, thus'. The earliest bronze form may have had a different sound part that only later took the shape of 其.

斯.name: thus

origin.says: Simplified from 藝, first written 埶 (a person planting); 艹 (plant) and 云 were added later. The simplified form keeps 艹 and puts 乙 (second) as a sound part: planting skill, then art and craft.
From 僅: 亻 (person) for the meaning plus 堇 (clay) as the sound: barely, only. The simplification put 又 (hand) in place of 堇.
氵 (water) for the meaning plus 㒼 (to cover tightly) as the sound: water up to the brim, full. Simplified from 滿, with the sound part shortened to 艹 over 两.

ety.hint: The lot or portion 分 allotted to a man 亻

origin.says: 亻 (person) for the meaning plus 分 (divide) as the sound, which also fits: the part given to each person, a share, a portion; also a counting word for copies.
A picture of a river with a bit of dry land in it: an islet. The word came to mean a region or province; 洲 (continent) took over the island sense.

笑.def: to smile, to laugh; to giggle; to snicker

ety.hint: A person 夭 with a big grin ⺮

origin.says: Today 𥫗 (bamboo) plus 夭 (young, bending) as the sound part; why bamboo stands for laughing is unclear. An older form used grass with 犬 (dog), so sources disagree on the first build.

笑.name: laugh

省.def: province; frugal; to save, to leave out

origin.says: Originally 生 (grow) as the sound over 目 (eye): to inspect. The top 生 later wore down into 少 (few). From inspecting came 'province' and 'to save, leave out'.

省.name: inspect

伤.def: to injure, to harm; wound, injury; to fall ill

origin.says: From 傷: 亻 (person) for the meaning plus a sound part with 昜 (sunrise) at the bottom: a wound. The simplification put 力 (strength) in place of 昜.

伤.name: injury

origin.says: From 堅: 土 (earth) for the meaning plus 臤 (firm; a hand 又 holding a servant's eye 臣) as the sound: hard, firm earth. The simplified form writes 臣 (eye) as two short strokes, keeping 又 (hand) and 土 (earth).

置.def: to lay out, to place, to set aside

origin.says: 罒 (net) for the meaning plus 直 (straight) as the sound: first to let go from a net, then to put, set, place, install.

置.name: set down

低.def: low; to lower, to hang; to bend, to bow

origin.says: 亻 (person) for the meaning plus 氐 (base, root) as the sound: a person bowing down, hence low. 氐 also carries the idea of 'down'.

低.name: low

origin.says: Simplified from 熱: 埶 (to plant) as the sound plus 灬 (fire) for the meaning: hot. The simplified top uses the shape 执 (to hold).

送.def: to see off, to send off, to dispatch; to give

ety.hint: A person waving 关 to someone walking away 辶

origin.says: 辶 (walking) plus 灷 (two hands holding up fire or an object) as the sound and meaning: to walk carrying something, to deliver, to see someone off. The top has warped into the shape 关.

送.name: send off

均.def: equal, even, fair; level, uniform; also, too

origin.says: 土 (earth) for the meaning plus 匀 (even, evenly divided) for the sound: levelled ground, hence equal and even.

均.name: equal

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 比 (compare) as the sound: first to strike with the hand; now to comment on, and a batch.
Strokes of breath rising, built on 丂: to breathe out, to call (later written 呼). Its use as a question or exclamation particle is a sound loan.
广 (building) for the meaning plus 氐 (base) as the sound: the foundation of a building, hence the bottom of anything.

土.def: soil, earth; items made of earth

ety.hint: A lump of clay on a potter's wheel

origin.says: A picture of a mound or lump of earth standing on the ground line; the mound narrowed into the short top stroke. Meaning: soil, earth.

土.name: earth
土.in: 在地等起场社持特基调城走增周境型超越待域坚均压坏街趣址培幸怪赶块封堂坐坛座佳诗徒挂圣趋塔坦墙圾垃脏赴塞鞋埃寺堡塑哇堆吐填

origin.says: Simplified from 剛: 刂 (knife) for the meaning plus 岡 (ridge) as the sound: hard, firm like a blade; 'just now' is a later use. The simplified form writes 岡 as 冈.

ety.hint: A dog 犬 rushing out of a cave 穴

origin.says: 犬 (dog) under 穴 (cave, den): a dog bursting out of its den, hence sudden, to dash out.
